properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 29 at 6:40AM MST until September 29 at 9:30AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
At 640 AM MST, gauge reports indicated thunderstorms produced heavy
rain across the warned area. Between 0.75 and 1.25 inches of rain
have fallen. This has resulted in flowing of washes and creeks within
the warned area causing flash flooding, particularly affecting low
water crossings. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.75 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to
begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Gauges reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
streets and low water crossings.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Phoenix, New River, Cave Creek, Carefree, Anthem and Seven Springs.

Gauges along Skunk Creek and Cave Creek are showing elevated flow,
likely impacting low water crossings.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.senderName: NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 29 at 7:30AM MDT until September 29 at 10:30AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
FFWEPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Dona Ana County in south central New Mexico...

* Until 1030 AM MDT.

* At 730 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of rain
has fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Leasburg, Radium Springs and Hill.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain.
Arroyos, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 29 at 6:27AM MST until September 29 at 9:45AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Paria River in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 945 AM MST /1045 AM MDT/.

* At 627 AM MST /727 AM MDT/, a few hours ago, a river gauge on the
Paria River in Utah reported a rapid rise of 4.47 feet from heavy
rain over the Paria River, and has started to decrease a couple of
feet. This means the flood wave is currently moving through the
Paria River within Arizona. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Heavy rain producing
flash flooding in and around the Paria River.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Paria Canyon, Paria River Slot Canyon, Vermilion Cliffs National
Monument and Lees Ferry.

This includes the Colorado River near mile marker 0.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River and Paria River.
properties.instruction:
Get out of the Paria River slot canyon! Flood waters will flow down
the Paria River, reaching the confluence with the Colorado River at
Lees Ferry.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 9:45 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 9:45 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
